Home.Tagline: Training that suits you. A community that motivates you.
Home.Description: At CrossFit Leek, you train to become stronger, fitter, and more confident. Whether you have been exercising for years, are just starting out, or are looking to get back into shape, you train at your own level with expert coaching and a group of people who motivate one another.

Hero.subheadline: Training that fits you. A community that keeps you motivated.
Hero.body: At CrossFit Leek, you train to get stronger, fitter, and more confident. Whether you've been training for years, you're just starting out, or you're building back up: you train at your own level, with solid coaching and a group of people who motivate each other.
Hero.ctaIntro: Start with 2 trial weeks and discover if CrossFit Leek is right for you.
